payload.rebuttal: fixed: branch_heads deliberately sets a layer's base and diff_base to the same chosen value, so swapping .diff_base for .base in the join's prompt call is a true no-op for any layer branch_heads resolves, and no fixture built on branch_heads alone could ever catch it. I added a case that wraps branch_heads with a fake resolver that corrupts only one layer's .base while leaving its .diff_base and .head untouched, then asserted the join's stated range reflects the uncorrupted diff_base, which fails when the wrong attribute is read.
